cohort.definition: per run, one completed call for each of the 70 scenarios: the original valid call, or its user-authorized replacement -- the single rerun of a call stopped at the 900 s call budget, or the build-v4 rerun of a call whose mock-tool fixture raised an error. Superseded attempts are excluded from all results.

metric_value_note: value: the final scalar metric result (bool/number or null); passed: the scorer-normalized skill verdict (null = not reached). Failure QC covers reviewed failures and targeted diagnostic calls under the configured benchmark rubrics. No explanations, transcripts, recordings, task targets or provider payloads are included.

components.name: backend gpt-6-sol
components.note: Short-context rates; the backend's prompts in these calls are a few thousand tokens.

rates.gpt_live_1_1_check: OpenAI pricing page read 2026-11-20: gpt-live-1.1 $0.05/min active, same as gpt-live-1; gpt-6-sol unchanged

cost.basis: live model billed per minute of live audio (session seconds reported by the service); backend GPT-6 Sol billed per token from the delegated responses' usage
cost.excluded: caller-side services (ElevenLabs, OpenRouter), infrastructure-invalid attempts and superseded attempts (timed-out and fixture-invalid calls that were replaced)
